notes.title: Demo Re-Release!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! I hope you are all doing well. It's been a long seven or eight months. I've been working quietly on contracts to keep myself alive, and this game in my every waking moment when I'm not doing that. Since the last demo, [b]nearly every system in the entire game has received a makeover in the form of a redesign or rebuild[/b]. There are so, so many things that have changed and the playtesters are having a lot of fun with it, and so am I.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, I am announcing that the Demo build has reached a point where I am comfortable giving it to the public! The demo includes only [b]the Tutorial level, [i]Crash Course[/i][/b][i], [/i]and [b]the first playable Class, the [i]Knight[/i][/b], as well as the associated challenge pages, and the challenges within. In total, I am hoping to give you [b]2-4 hours of free content[/b] as a teaser of what is to come. Be on the lookout soon for more announcements. I have a lot of stuff in store for you![/p][p][/p][p]-Skylor[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111560"][/dynamiclink][/p]
